name: 龙虎榜掘金
description_zh: 深度拆解龙虎榜明细与席位博弈，识别机构 / 北向 / 游资真实意图，输出买卖力量评分、游资追踪、三日榜"边拉边撤"预警。适合关注资金面与席位行为的用户。
description_en: Deep-dive analysis of Dragon Tiger Board (longhubang) details and seat-level trading dynamics. Identify the real intentions of institutions, northbound capital, and hot-money retail traders. Output buy-sell power scores, hot-money tracking, and three-day board pull-and-dump warnings.
